articles.title: Angels’ Ben Joyce still working back into form after shoulder surgery
articles.description: Joyce, who missed a season and a half recovering from shoulder surgery, has been back since early August, but he still is trying to get comfortable with his slider and improve his control.

articles.title: A season of learning comes to an end for Angels’ Nolan Schanuel
articles.description: Schanuel has been out since Aug. 20 because of a strained intercostal muscle. He played one game of a rehab assignment before feeling more soreness, so the Angels decided on Friday to end his season.
